topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, now, it seems Old Man Jensen's got more in his coffers than the village rumors gave him credit for. Who would've thought? All this time mending his own shoes and patching his roof, he's been sitting on a fortune. I've seen him peddle his wares at the market, simple folk like the rest of us, but there's always been something about the glint in his eye. Maybe it’s a touch of the saints shining through. Folks say he dug up some treasure from days of yore, or perhaps he’s just been frugal, saving every copper. It’s a fair reminder that not all that’s valuable gleams in the sunlight. Still, the earth will turn, and we'll all keep sowing and reaping, as is right and just.
